market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.3m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela ~988k bpd in March 2026, growing slowly toward ~1.0-1.2m bpd. Reaching 1.3m bpd in any single 2026 month is plausible if recovery accelerates by H2, but OPEC secondary-source numbers tend to lag. Probably below market's 0.25.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of investment & sanctions trajectory through 2026.
